mapper.select: select t.nn, t.b, t.t, t.d, t.cn, t.cp, t.blind_n n, t.img0url, t.img1url is not null multiImage from curtain_article t where t.img0url is not null and t.img0url not like 'https://port-0%' order by t.n limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update blind_article set img0url = #{portUrl}, updatedTime = now() where n = #{n}
update blind_article set activate = false, updatedTime = now() where activate = true and img0url is not null and n = #{n}
